class.name: IfcIrregularTimeSeriesValue
class.brief_description: The IfcIrregularTimeSeriesValue describes a value (or set of values) at a particular time point. HISTORY: New entity in IFC 2x2.

members.member: The specification of the time point. Its type depends on the file's schema: String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2, GDIFCEntityBase in IFC2X3.
A list of time-series values. At least one value is required.
